title: Pharaoh's soul guided through seven palaces in the Pyramid Texts

tellings.quote: If we go back even further to the oldest religious texts we have, the ancient Egyptian pyramid texts from 2400 BC, we see the pharaoh's soul is guided by the priests through the seven areet, also called, you guessed it, palaces.

plain: In the Pyramid Texts, the oldest religious writings of ancient Egypt, priests lead the soul of the pharaoh, Egypt's king, through seven "areet", a word Michels says also means palaces. Michels tells this himself, dating the texts to 2400 BC, in an episode about the idea that we live in a hologram. He raises it to show that the image of seven palaces goes back to the very oldest scripture we have.
